description: Encode text to hex (UTF-8) and decode hex back to text, with optional 0x prefixes, separators and uppercase output.

faqs.a: Characters are encoded as UTF-8 bytes, so emoji and non-Latin scripts work: 'é' becomes c3a9 (2 bytes), '😀' becomes f09f9880 (4 bytes).
faqs.q: Does it handle emoji and non-English text?

faqs.a: The decoder strips 0x prefixes, spaces, dashes, colons and newlines automatically, so you can paste hex copied from logs, editors or debuggers.
faqs.q: Can I paste hex with spaces or 0x prefixes?

faqs.a: Odd-length hex, characters outside 0-9/a-f, and invalid UTF-8 byte sequences are rejected with a clear error message.

howto: Choose the direction: text → hex or hex → text.
Adjust options (0x prefix, separators, case) and copy the result.
title: Hex String Converter
